# Joinmassive.com

> Massive is a 100% ethical data collection infrastructure provider offering a Web Access API (residential proxies), ISP Proxies, Web Search API, Web Render API, and a Web Data Marketplace — all built on ethically-sourced infrastructure with 99.87% success rates (US), 0.52s average response time, 1.6M+ residential IPs across 195+ countries, and compliance certifications including AppEsteem, GDPR, CCPA, and AMTSO membership.

## Products

- [Web Access API](https://www.joinmassive.com/web-access): Ethically-Sourced Residential Proxies | 99.87% Success Rate, 0.52s Response Time, 1.6M+ IPs across 195+ Countries
- [Web Search API](https://www.joinmassive.com/web-search): Structured Google SERP Data | Real-time search results with geo-targeting across 195+ countries, clean JSON output
- [Web Render API](https://www.joinmassive.com/web-render): JavaScript Rendering & Antibot Bypass | Full headless browser execution, CAPTCHA bypass, routed through residential IPs
- [Massive MCP](https://www.joinmassive.com/mcp): Model Context Protocol server for AI agents | One npm install gives Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, and any MCP-compatible agent direct access to query frontier LLMs, search Google, and render any webpage — geo-targeted to 195+ countries
- [Web Data Marketplace](https://www.joinmassive.com/web-data-marketplace): Browse trusted web data providers and scraping services through Massive's curated marketplace
